articles.title: The Silk Road
articles.body:
The Silk Road was never a single road, nor was it used only for silk. It was a shifting web of routes that linked China to the Mediterranean, crossing deserts, mountains, and the territories of many peoples.

Goods certainly moved along it — silk travelling west, but also glass, spices, and horses in many directions. Yet historians increasingly stress that ideas travelled just as far. Religions, technologies, and artistic styles spread between distant cultures, carried by the very merchants who carried cloth.

The network declined as sea routes grew cheaper and safer from the fifteenth century onward. Even so, its lasting importance lies less in the trade itself than in what that trade made possible: sustained contact between civilisations that might otherwise have remained strangers.

items.q: According to the text, the Silk Road was —
What does the passage emphasise besides goods?
items.tr: Tarihçiler fikirlerin de en az mallar kadar yol aldığını vurguluyor.

opts: Sea routes became cheaper and safer

listening.title: At the museum desk
listening.script: Good morning, welcome to the City Museum. — Hi, two adult tickets, please. — That's sixteen pounds. The special exhibition on the second floor is included. — Great. What time do you close? — At half past five today. — Thank you!

items.q: How much are the tickets in total?
What time does the museum close today?

grammar.title: Modals: must / have to
grammar.exp: 'must' genelde konuşanın kendi koyduğu zorunluluğu anlatır (I must call her). 'have to' ise dışarıdan gelen, kural kaynaklı zorunluluğu anlatır (I have to wear a uniform). Olumsuzda anlam değişir: 'mustn't' = yasak; 'don't have to' = gerek yok.

items.q: At my job I ___ wear a uniform; it's the rule.
You ___ touch that wire — it's dangerous!
It's Sunday, so we ___ get up early.

writing.prompt: Write a formal email to a company about a product that arrived damaged. Explain the problem and say what you want them to do.
writing.tips: Resmî dil kullan (Dear Sir/Madam). Sorunu net anlat, sipariş bilgisini ver, açık bir talep (iade/değişim) ekle, nazik kapat.
writing.structure: Selamlama -> sorun + sipariş detayı -> net talep -> kapanış (I look forward to...).
